about: Synthetic test life no. 2 for the memory-structure bake-off (2026-10-31). Fictional person, every fact invented; no owner data. Messages are what the person says to Jarvis, in date order, in English, Tamil and Tanglish. Questions are asked 'today' = 2026-10-31. Scoring is the same as test_life.json: an answer passes when every group in 'must' has at least one alternative in the answer (case-insensitive) and no 'must_not' term appears; 'abstain' questions pass only when the answer says it doesn't know and states no value. Alternatives of 3 characters or fewer match as whole words only. Kinds as in test_life.json plus 'connected' (needs two facts said far apart) and 'old_fact' (said once, more than six months before today, never repeated). 'gold' is a right answer and 'traps' are wrong answers that must fail; the runner ignores both (scripts/check_memory_eval_data.py checks them). BIG version: the same facts and questions plus 1000 everyday messages (make_big_life.py, seed 20261031); none changes a right answer.
